experiment_id.title: Experiment Id
experiment_id.description: Id of the experiment that was started; poll it for progress.

Accepted.title: Accepted
Accepted.description: Returned when work was queued and continues in the background.

type.title: Type
type.description: Check type, e.g. `sql`, `tool_order` or `decision`; `budget` for limits.

description.title: Description
description.description: Human-readable statement of what was checked.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: Whether a failure blocks the release gate.

status.title: Status
status.description: `unsupported`: could not be evaluated (missing evidence, judge abstained or errored). `skipped`: not applicable to this run.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Why it passed or failed, with the observed values.

AssertionResult.title: AssertionResult
AssertionResult.description: The outcome of one check on one trial.

environment.description: The drafted environment; set only when a new one was drafted.

scenario.description: The drafted scenario; null only when no attempt produced a parseable one (then `valid` is false).

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: Whether the draft passed validation and can be saved.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Problems remaining after the repair attempts.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Assumptions the author model made, for a human to review.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Model calls made, including repair attempts.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Total model spend in US dollars, if reported.

AuthorDraft.title: AuthorDraft
AuthorDraft.description: A model-written draft, already validated against a real temporary environment. Never saved automatically.

description.title: Description
description.description: The scenario to build, in plain English.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Existing environment key to build on; null drafts a new environment too.

AuthorRequest.title: AuthorRequest
AuthorRequest.description: Ask a model to draft a scenario (and optionally its environment) from plain English.

max_tool_calls.title: Max Tool Calls
max_tool_calls.description: Most tool calls the agent may make (ledger entries).

max_latency_ms.title: Max Latency Ms
max_latency_ms.description: Longest allowed invoke time, in milliseconds.

max_cost_usd.title: Max Cost Usd
max_cost_usd.description: Highest allowed model spend in US dollars, as reported by the adapter.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Optional per-trial ceilings; each set limit becomes a non-critical check.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: The environment's tool names, for faults, `tool_order`, `forbidden_tool` and events.

seed_columns.title: Seed Columns
seed_columns.description: The environment's tables, each with its column names.

assertion_types.title: Assertion Types
assertion_types.description: Check types a new scenario may use.

judge_models.title: Judge Models
judge_models.description: Suggested decision models; the first is the default judge.

question.title: Question
question.description: Question about the evidence whose true answer the environment knows.

truth_sql.title: Truth Sql
truth_sql.description: Read-only SELECT over the trial schema returning a single cell, compared as a string to the answer.

Calibration.title: Calibration
Calibration.description: Asked in the same judge call; the truth comes from the environment, so it scores evidence-reading accuracy.

label.title: Label
label.description: Unique name for this example within its check.

evidence.description: Evidence as a judge would see it, keyed by kind, e.g. `{"output": "...", "final_state": {...}}`.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: The verdict a correct judge must reach.

Canary.title: Canary
Canary.description:
A labelled example for a decision check: evidence exactly as a judge would see it, and the right verdict.
Canaries measure verdict accuracy, which calibration questions (evidence reading) cannot.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: Scenario `id@version` whose check owns the canary.

correct.title: Correct
correct.description: Whether `verdict` equals `expected`; an abstain is never correct.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Cost of the judge call in US dollars, if reported.

CanaryResult.title: CanaryResult
CanaryResult.description: One judge's verdict on one canary, recorded to measure verdict accuracy.

invoke.title: Invoke
invoke.description: Accepts `POST /invoke`. Always true for a working harness.

observe.title: Observe
observe.description: How much of the run the harness reveals: `native_events` streams the full event list in the response, `otel_partial` exports OpenTelemetry spans only, `none` is a black box.

intercept_tools.title: Intercept Tools
intercept_tools.description: `declared_only` means the harness applies the `tool_faults` it receives at its own tool boundary; `none` means it ignores them.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Emits `checkpoint_saved` events that a run can be resumed from.

resume.title: Resume
resume.description: Can continue a prior trial from a checkpoint (`resume_from`).

fork.title: Fork
fork.description: Can branch a prior trial's checkpoint into a new run (`resume_from`).

Capabilities.title: Capabilities
Capabilities.description: What a harness can do beyond plain invoke; the runner skips or marks checks the harness cannot support.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The question to answer about the evidence.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Option name to description of when it applies.

ChoiceQuestion.title: ChoiceQuestion
ChoiceQuestion.description: Pick exactly one option; the judge also reports its confidence in the pick.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: Pass when the judge picks any of these options.

ChoiceRule.title: ChoiceRule
ChoiceRule.description: Pass rule for a choice question.

name.title: Name
name.description: Column name: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter (max 48).

type.description: Postgres type the column is created with.

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Part of the table's primary key (several columns make a composite key).

unique.title: Unique
unique.description: Values must be distinct across rows.

serial.title: Serial
serial.description: Auto-incrementing integer key. Deterministic, so ledger replay reproduces the same ids.

Column.title: Column
Column.description: One column of an environment table.

protocol_version.title: Protocol Version
protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version the runner speaks.

auth_required.title: Auth Required
auth_required.description: Whether API calls need a bearer token.

suite_path.title: Suite Path
suite_path.description: Scenario file or directory the console reads.

targets_path.title: Targets Path
targets_path.description: Targets YAML file the console reads and edits.

ConsoleInfo.title: ConsoleInfo
ConsoleInfo.description: Static facts about the running console.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: A failure of this check blocks the release gate; an unsupported one withholds a pass.

requires_faults.title: Requires Faults
requires_faults.description: Only meaningful when the scenario's faults are active; skipped in runs without faults, e.g. clean forks.

description.title: Description
description.description: Label shown in results; a generated one is used when empty.

question.description: What the judges are asked about the evidence.

pass_rule.description: How an answer maps to pass; its kind must match the question's.

min_confidence.title: Min Confidence
min_confidence.description: Answers less confident than this abstain; a judge's own threshold overrides it.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Parts of the run shown to the judges.

judges.title: Judges
judges.description: Models that answer, in order; defaults to the built-in decision models.

strategy.description: `cascade`: the first confident judge decides. `jury`: only unanimous confident votes decide.

calibration.description: Optional evidence-reading question asked alongside, to score each judge's accuracy.

canaries.title: Canaries
canaries.description: Labelled examples measuring each judge's verdict accuracy; need one pass and one fail.

Decision-Input.title: Decision
Decision-Input.description:
A model-judged check: typed question about the evidence, thresholded into pass / fail / abstain (unsupported).

A critical fail only blocks when the judges that decided it are calibrated (see verdicts.uncalibrated_reason).

scenario.description: The scenario to run; it may be unsaved.

target.title: Target
target.description: Target name to run it on.

DryRunRequest.title: DryRunRequest
DryRunRequest.description: Run one scenario once on one target without saving it.

EnvironmentDraft.title: EnvironmentDraft
EnvironmentDraft.description: An environment to validate or save.

EnvironmentInfo.title: EnvironmentInfo
EnvironmentInfo.description: An environment spec with its lookup key.

id.title: Id
id.description: Environment id: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`.

version.title: Version
version.description: Bumped whenever the spec changes; scenarios pin `id@version`.

description.title: Description
description.description: The world in plain English; also given to agents as context.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: Tables created for every trial; names are unique.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tools the agent can call; names are unique.

EnvironmentSpec.title: EnvironmentSpec
EnvironmentSpec.description: A versioned environment: the tables and tools of one simulated world.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: What went wrong, in plain English; never echoes secrets or input values.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Body of every non-validation error response.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Position in the run, starting at 1. Ordering always uses `seq`, never `ts`.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: Unix time in seconds; informational, clocks differ across runtimes.

span_id.title: Span Id
span_id.description: Identifier of this step, for correlating with traces.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: `span_id` of the step that caused this one.

data.description: Event payload. `tool_failed`: `{"injected": bool, "committed": bool}` when a fault fired. `checkpoint_saved`: `{"checkpoint_id": str}`.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: A failure of this check blocks the release gate; an unsupported one withholds a pass.

requires_faults.title: Requires Faults
requires_faults.description: Only meaningful when the scenario's faults are active; skipped in runs without faults, e.g. clean forks.

description.title: Description
description.description: Label shown in results; a generated one is used when empty.

event.title: Event
event.description: Event type that must appear, e.g. `approval_requested`.

name.title: Name
name.description: Also require this tool name on the event; any name if omitted.

EventPresent.title: EventPresent
EventPresent.description: Process evidence from inside the harness; unsupported unless the adapter streams native events.

decision.description: Release decision; null until all trials finish.

Experiment.title: Experiment
Experiment.description: A batch of trials with its plan and release decision.

trials.title: Trials
trials.description: Every trial with its evidence and check results.

ExperimentDetail.title: ExperimentDetail
ExperimentDetail.description: An experiment with all of its trials.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.description: Scenarios run, by `id@version`, as they were at start.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Environment specs pinned at plan time; absent in history recorded before pinning.

repeats.title: Repeats
repeats.description: Times each scenario ran on each target.

fixture_url.title: Fixture Url
fixture_url.description: Base URL of the fixture service as agents saw it.

forked_from.description: Checkpoint this experiment forked, if it is a fork.

max_regression.description: Pass-rate drop vs the baseline that is tolerated, from 0 to 1.

ExperimentMeta.description: The plan of an experiment, pinned at start so history stays reproducible.

status.description: Whether its trials are still running or it has a decision.

decision.description: Release decision; null until the experiment completes.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Trials that could not be graded.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Total agent spend in US dollars, if reported.

forked_from.description: Checkpoint this experiment forked; null if not a fork.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the job died, if it did.

ExperimentSummary.description: One row of the experiment list.

critical.description: A failure of this check blocks the release gate; an unsupported one withholds a pass.

requires_faults.description: Only meaningful when the scenario's faults are active; skipped in runs without faults, e.g. clean forks.

description.description: Label shown in results; a generated one is used when empty.

name.description: Tool that must never be called, whether or not the call succeeded.

target.description: Target to resume on; defaults to the source trial's target.

faults.description: `scenario` re-applies the scenario's faults; `none` runs the fork clean.

answer.description: The answer as returned, e.g. `{"type": "noul", "noul": 0.02}` or `{"type": "choice", "choice": "...", "confidence": 0.9}`; `{"type": "error", ...}` if the call failed.

calibration_answer.description: The judge's answer to the calibration question, if the check has one.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Cost of this judge call in US dollars, if reported.

JudgeAnswer.title: JudgeAnswer
JudgeAnswer.description: One decision model's typed answer (Decisions API), kept verbatim for audit.

model.title: Model
model.description: OpenRouter model id, pinned to an exact version, e.g. `typesafe/jev-1.14`.

api.title: Api
api.description: `decisions`: the OpenRouter Decisions API. `chat`: any chat model with JSON-schema output.

min_confidence.title: Min Confidence
min_confidence.description: This judge's own confidence threshold, overriding the check's; probabilities are not comparable across models.

JudgeSpec.title: JudgeSpec
JudgeSpec.description: One judge model and how to call it.

correct.title: Correct
correct.description: Calibration answers that matched the ground truth.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: `correct / samples` from 0 to 1; null before any sample.

canary_samples.title: Canary Samples
canary_samples.description: Canary verdicts seen, excluding judge errors.

canary_correct.title: Canary Correct
canary_correct.description: Canary verdicts that matched the expected label.

canary_accuracy.title: Canary Accuracy
canary_accuracy.description: `canary_correct / canary_samples` from 0 to 1; null before any canary.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Total spend on this model's calls in US dollars, if reported.

calibrated.title: Calibrated
calibrated.description: Meets both accuracy bars, so critical decision checks may block releases.

JudgeStats.description:
Per-model track record on two bars: evidence reading (calibration questions answered alongside real
verdicts) and verdict accuracy (labelled canaries). Both must pass before a critical check may block.

judges.title: Judges
judges.description: Answers from the judges that were asked, in order.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: Combined outcome. `abstain` means low confidence, judges disagreed, or an error.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Each judge's vote, joined for display.

calibration_truth.title: Calibration Truth
calibration_truth.description: Ground truth read from SQL for the calibration question.

calibration_correct.title: Calibration Correct
calibration_correct.description: Judge model to whether its calibration answer matched the truth.

JudgeVerdict.title: JudgeVerdict
JudgeVerdict.description: What the judges decided for one decision check, and why.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Order of the call within the trial's ledger.

committed.title: Committed
committed.description: Whether the call's side effect persisted, even if the caller saw an error.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: Unix time in seconds when the call was recorded.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description:
One tool call as the environment saw it.

`committed` means its side effect persisted, even if the caller saw an error.

protocol_version.title: Protocol Version
protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version the harness speaks; a mismatch is refused.

adapter_id.title: Adapter Id
adapter_id.description: Stable identifier of this adapter, e.g. `acme-support-bot`.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language the harness is written in, e.g. `python` or `typescript`.

framework.title: Framework
framework.description: Agent framework in use, e.g. `langgraph`; `custom` if none.

instructions.description: The statement to judge, phrased so that true means the agent did well.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Exactly two keys, `"true"` and `"false"`, each describing when that answer applies.

NoulQuestion.description: Probability that the statement is true. criteria keys: "true" and "false".

noul_at_least.title: Noul At Least
noul_at_least.description: Pass when the probability of true is at least this.

NoulRule.title: NoulRule
NoulRule.description: Pass rule for a noul question.

pairs.title: Pairs
pairs.description: Scenario-repeat pairs graded on both targets.

regressions.title: Regressions
regressions.description: Pairs that passed on the baseline but failed on the candidate.

fixes.title: Fixes
fixes.description: Pairs that failed on the baseline but passed on the candidate.

Paired.title: Paired
Paired.description: Same scenario and repeat compared between baseline and candidate, where both were graded.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Result rows, each a list of cell values.

value.description: Single-cell result as a scalar, exactly as the `sql` check compares it; null otherwise.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the query failed; null when `ok`.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Rows to insert first, keyed by table name.

query.title: Query
query.description: Read-only SELECT to run, as a `sql` check would.

QueryTest.description: A SQL query to try against a temporary seeded environment.

critical.description: A failure of this check blocks the release gate; an unsupported one withholds a pass.

requires_faults.description: Only meaningful when the scenario's faults are active; skipped in runs without faults, e.g. clean forks.

description.title: Description

RetiredCheck.description:

are kept as-is), but it never runs: always `skipped`. New scenarios may not use it (see scenario.retired).

sql.title: Sql
sql.description: One SELECT returning a single boolean; true means the call must be refused.

status.description: HTTP status returned to the agent when the rule fires.

error.description: Message returned to the agent when the rule fires.

A precondition evaluated before the effect. `sql` is one SELECT returning a single boolean cell, with the

side effect (e.g. "insufficient seats" -> 409).

query.title: Query
query.description: One read-only SELECT over the trial's tables, run after the agent finishes.

equals.description: Expected result: a scalar when the query returns a single cell, else a list of row lists.

Sql.title: Sql
Sql.description: Read-only SQL over the environment's final state; a single-cell result is compared as a scalar.

name.title: Name
name.description: Table name: lowercase letters, digits and `_`; `ledger` and `idempotency` are reserved.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Columns, in order; at least one.

Table.title: Table
Table.description: A table created in the trial's private Postgres schema.

added.title: Added
added.description: Rows present at the end but not at the start.

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: Rows present at the start but not at the end.

TableDiff.title: TableDiff
TableDiff.description: Rows that differ in one table between the start and end of a trial.

name.title: Name
name.description: Target name, up to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`.

TargetDraft.title: TargetDraft
TargetDraft.description: A target to test or save.

name.title: Name
name.description: Target name from the targets file.

mode.description: How the harness is reached: `native`, `http` or `otel`.

url.title: Url
url.description: Harness base URL with credentials redacted; null if none.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version label of the system under test.

manifest.description: Live manifest when reachable (native), else the declared one (http/otel); null if none.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the probe failed, redacted; null when reachable.

TargetHealth.title: TargetHealth
TargetHealth.description: A configured target and whether its harness answered a manifest probe.

mode.description: How the harness is reached: `native`, `http` or `otel`.

url.title: Url
url.description: Harness base URL; null for targets without one.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version label of the system under test.

manifest.description: The harness manifest, live or as declared; null if none.

TargetInfo.title: TargetInfo
TargetInfo.description: A target as it was when the experiment was planned.

mode.description: `native`: harness implements the AgentLab protocol. `http`: any endpoint that takes the scenario input as a JSON POST. `otel`: observe-only, cannot be invoked.

url.title: Url
url.description: Harness base URL (native) or endpoint to POST to (http); its host must be in `allowed_hosts`.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version label of the system under test, shown in results.

manifest.description: Capabilities declared by the user for http/otel targets, which expose no manifest.

TargetSpec.title: TargetSpec
TargetSpec.description: How to reach a harness, as written under `targets:` in the targets file.

graded.title: Graded
graded.description: Trials that were graded (passed or failed).

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Trials that could not be graded; excluded from rates.

pass_rate.title: Pass Rate
pass_rate.description: `passed / graded` from 0 to 1; null when nothing was graded.

ci95.title: Ci95
ci95.description: 95% Wilson confidence interval of the pass rate, as (low, high).

p50_ms.title: P50 Ms
p50_ms.description: Median latency of graded trials, in milliseconds.

p95_ms.title: P95 Ms
p95_ms.description: 95th-percentile latency of graded trials, in milliseconds.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Total agent spend in US dollars; null if no trial reported cost.

pass_all_k.title: Pass All K
pass_all_k.description: pass^k: share of scenarios whose every repeat passed (k = repeats); exposes flakiness a pass rate hides.

k.title: K
k.description: Most repeats any scenario had; the k in `pass_all_k`.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: A failure of this check blocks the release gate; an unsupported one withholds a pass.

requires_faults.title: Requires Faults
requires_faults.description: Only meaningful when the scenario's faults are active; skipped in runs without faults, e.g. clean forks.

description.title: Description
description.description: Label shown in results; a generated one is used when empty.

before.title: Before
before.description: Tool that must not be called until `requires` has succeeded.

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: Tool that must have a successful (non-error) call earlier in the ledger.

ToolOrder.title: ToolOrder
ToolOrder.description: `requires` must succeed (2xx) in the side-effect ledger before the first `before` call.

name.title: Name
name.description: Parameter name; bound into the tool's SQL as `%(name)s`.

type.description: JSON type the agent must supply.

description.title: Description
description.description: Shown to the agent in the tool catalog.

required.title: Required
required.description: Calls without this argument are rejected (422).

enum.title: Enum
enum.description: Allowed values, compared as strings; omit for any value.

ToolParam.title: ToolParam
ToolParam.description: One typed argument of a tool.

name.title: Name
name.description: Tool name the agent calls; lowercase letters, digits and `_`.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the tool does, shown to the agent in the tool catalog.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Preconditions checked in order before the SQL runs.

sql.title: Sql
sql.description: The single SQL statement to run; add RETURNING to send rows back.

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: Response shape: `row` is the first row (404 when none), `rows` is a list, `none` is `{}`.

idempotent.title: Idempotent
idempotent.description: Adds an `idempotency_key` argument; a repeated key replays the first response without re-running.

mutates.title: Mutates
mutates.description: False for read-only tools; they are still recorded in the ledger but never committed.

ToolSpec.title: ToolSpec
ToolSpec.description:
One tool: typed parameters, optional rules, then ONE SQL statement (parameters bound as %(name)s; use
RETURNING to send rows back). Runs as the trial's writer role: it can change this environment's tables only.

target.title: Target
target.description: Name of the target that ran it.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Zero-based repeat index within the experiment.

status.description: `running`, then `passed` or `failed` once graded, or `error` if it could not be graded.

Trial.title: Trial
Trial.description: One run of one scenario on one target.

message.title: Message
message.description: What went wrong, with secrets redacted.

TrialError.title: TrialError
TrialError.description: Why a trial could not be graded: an infrastructure failure, never an agent failure.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Harness-side run id; null if the harness never replied.

agent_status.title: Agent Status
agent_status.description: Whether the agent finished its run, as the harness reported it.

events.title: Events
events.description: Steps the harness reported, if it streams events.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Every tool call the environment received, in order.

initial_state.description: Table contents before the agent ran.

final_state.description: Table contents after the agent ran.

state_diff.title: State Diff
state_diff.description: Per-table rows added or removed by the run; unchanged tables are omitted.

assertions.title: Assertions
assertions.description: Results of every check, budget limits last.

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Wall-clock time of the invoke call, in milliseconds.

error.description: Set when the trial errored instead of being graded.

resumed_from.description: Checkpoint this trial continued from, for forks.

TrialRecord.title: TrialRecord
TrialRecord.description: Everything captured while running and grading one trial.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens consumed across all model calls.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Completion tokens produced across all model calls.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Total model spend in US dollars.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Resource use the harness reports for a run; omitted values are unknown, not zero.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: The reason, or one entry per invalid field.

ValidationFailure.title: ValidationFailure
ValidationFailure.description: Body of a 422 response: a message, or FastAPI's list of field problems when the body failed to parse.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: A failure of this check blocks the release gate; an unsupported one withholds a pass.

requires_faults.title: Requires Faults
requires_faults.description: Only meaningful when the scenario's faults are active; skipped in runs without faults, e.g. clean forks.

description.title: Description
description.description: Label shown in results; a generated one is used when empty.

question.description: What the judges are asked about the evidence.

pass_rule.description: How an answer maps to pass; its kind must match the question's.

min_confidence.title: Min Confidence
min_confidence.description: Answers less confident than this abstain; a judge's own threshold overrides it.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Parts of the run shown to the judges.

judges.title: Judges
judges.description: Models that answer, in order; defaults to the built-in decision models.

strategy.description: `cascade`: the first confident judge decides. `jury`: only unanimous confident votes decide.

calibration.description: Optional evidence-reading question asked alongside, to score each judge's accuracy.

canaries.title: Canaries
canaries.description: Labelled examples measuring each judge's verdict accuracy; need one pass and one fail.

agentlab__assertions__Decision.title: Decision
agentlab__assertions__Decision.description:
A model-judged check: typed question about the evidence, thresholded into pass / fail / abstain (unsupported).

A critical fail only blocks when the judges that decided it are calibrated (see verdicts.uncalibrated_reason).

status.description: `PASS`, `BLOCK` (a critical check failed or the pass rate regressed), or `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` (errors or unsupported critical checks).

block_reasons.title: Block Reasons
block_reasons.description: Why the release is blocked; empty unless `BLOCK`.

insufficient_reasons.title: Insufficient Reasons
insufficient_reasons.description: What evidence is missing; empty unless `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`.

coverage_gaps.title: Coverage Gaps
coverage_gaps.description: Non-critical checks the harness could not support.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Aggregates per target name (candidate and baseline).

paired.description: Candidate-vs-baseline comparison; null without a baseline.

agentlab__models__Decision.title: Decision
agentlab__models__Decision.description: The release decision for a candidate.
